reason: Humanize is an AI-assisted development workflow plugin centered on plan generation, iterative implementation, parallel prototyping, and independent Codex review, with optional Gemini research and progress monitoring.

summaries.zh: Humanize 通过计划生成、并行原型探索和独立 AI 代码审查，支持持续迭代的软件开发工作流。
summaries.en: Humanize supports iterative software development through plan generation, parallel prototyping, and independent AI code review.

capabilities: Generates development plans and capability maps
Orchestrates iterative implementation and independent AI code-review loops
Invokes external Codex and Gemini CLI tools when configured
Dispatches parallel prototype workers in isolated git worktrees
Creates planning, exploration, and review artifacts
Provides CLI monitoring for workflow and tool invocations
